needs_human.note: Text placed inside pdfminer LTFigure containers is not iterated: boxes are the top-level LTTextContainer children of the layout (pdf.py:107, 110, 117). On a predominantly vertical page this would drop such text from the 'complete pdfminer page text'. The spec does not say what to do here, and the pdfminer 20260107 source is not available in this review environment, so this is unverified.; A page whose vertical lines run bottom-to-top (0,-1) has an outcome the spec fixes only by exclusion (see F1); the spec does not say whether a human should revisit it.
